New Models and Protocols

This week in the AI ecosystem, new models were announced, with a particular focus on multi-agent systems and multimodal capabilities. The highlights are as follows:

  • Nvidia Nemotron 3: A new family of open-source models optimized for multi-agent systems was introduced.
  • OpenAI GPT Image 1.5 & GPT-5.2-Codex: Visual generation capabilities for ChatGPT were updated, while the software engineering-focused Codex version was released.
  • Google Gemini 3 Flash: This model, designed for low cost and high speed, has been made the default for search and Gemini applications.
  • AI2 Molmo 2 & Olmo 3.1: Molmo 2, capable of video analysis (object tracking, counting), and the open-world reasoning model Olmo 3.1 have been released.
  • Black Forest Labs FLUX.2: A state-of-the-art image model capable of generating visuals using real-time web data was announced.
  • Klarna Agentic Product Protocol: An open standard protocol that enables AI assistants to access over 100 million products has been introduced.
  • Alibaba Wan2.6: A multimodal model capable of generating HD video in as little as 15 seconds, with support for storyboards and character references.
  • xAI Grok Voice Agent API: A speech-to-speech audio technology API for developers has been released.
  • Meta SAM Audio: A model capable of extracting specific sounds from audio files using visual and text inputs has been released.

New Features and Integrations

Existing platforms and applications continue to integrate AI capabilities into their workflows:

  • Google Translate & CC: The translation service is becoming context-aware with the Gemini infrastructure, while the email-based assistant CC has begun testing.
  • Zoom AI Companion 3.0: A new version that connects meeting data to automated workflows has been introduced.
  • Adobe Firefly: Text commands and camera control features have been added for video editing and production processes.
  • OpenAI Third-Party Apps: Support for third-party apps that do not require external installation has been added to ChatGPT.
  • YouTube Playables Builder: A platform powered by Gemini 3 that enables game creation using text and visual commands has been announced.

Research Notes

Data from Stanford HAI and independent research reveal the models’ proficiency levels and future prospects:

  • CFA Exam Success: It was reported that GPT-5, Gemini 3.0 Pro, and other leading models passed all three levels of the CFA certification exams. Gemini 3.0 Pro achieved a 97.6% success rate on Level 1.
  • 2026 Forecasts: Stanford HAI predicts that the use of AI in healthcare will increase, but expectations for AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) will not materialize in the short term.

Investment Agenda

Capital flows in the sector continue, driven by high valuations and strategic partnerships:

  • Amazon & OpenAI: It has been reported that Amazon is preparing to invest $10 billion in OpenAI, and the valuation could exceed $500 billion.
  • Databricks: Raised over $4 billion at a $134 billion valuation.
  • Lovable: Raised $330 million in a Series B round, reaching a valuation of $6.6 billion.
  • Other Investments: Chai Discovery ($130M), Neural Concept ($100M), PolyAI ($86M), and Mirelo ($41M) have completed their funding rounds.
